# Merchant Financial Advisory LLC (MFA)

> Accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation and advisory firm in Princeton, New Jersey. Serves small and mid-sized businesses and individuals in New Jersey, New York City and nationwide, forms LLCs in all 50 states, and sells digital tax and bookkeeping tools. Founded by Zain Merchant, ACCA, formerly of PwC.

Contact: info@mfa-advisory.com, (347) 205-4468. Location: Princeton, New Jersey (no public street address; work is done remotely by video, phone and secure upload). Languages: English, Hindi, Urdu. Book a 30-minute consultation: https://mfa-advisory.com/#book. Replies to inquiries within one to three business days.

Not a law firm. MFA does not perform audits or issue audit, review or compilation reports. Content on the site is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.

## Services and public prices
- [Services](https://mfa-advisory.com/services/): tax preparation, tax planning, bookkeeping, financial reporting, fractional CFO, audit support, technical accounting, business advisory
- [LLC formation in all 50 states](https://mfa-advisory.com/llc-formation/): $150 / $249 / $649 plus the state fee, paid once; state-by-state fees and rules
- [Bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up](https://mfa-advisory.com/bookkeeping-cleanup/): fixed quote request

## Tools (online calculators and checkers)
- [Resources hub](https://mfa-advisory.com/resources/): all tools, calendars, templates and guides
- [1099 Contractor Tracker: Who Needs a 1099-NEC in 2026](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/1099-contractor-tracker/): Track vendors, W-9s and payments, see who needs a 1099-NEC at the 2026 $2,000 threshold, and export to CSV. Data stays in your browser.
- [1099 Tax Calculator 2026: Self-Employment, NJ & NY](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/1099-tax-calculator/): Estimate the self-employment tax, federal income tax and NJ or NY tax on your 1099 income, plus the share of every payment to set aside.
- [Break-Even Calculator for Small Businesses](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/break-even-calculator/): Find your break-even point in sales and units from monthly fixed costs, price and variable cost. For product and service businesses, with a profit goal.
- [Do I Need to Send a 1099? 2026 Payments Checker](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/do-i-need-to-send-a-1099/): Four questions show whether a 2026 payment needs a Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC: the $2,000 threshold, card and corporation exceptions, and deadlines.
- [Home Office Deduction Calculator 2026](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/home-office-deduction-calculator/): Compare the simplified ($5 per square foot, up to 300) and regular home office deduction methods for 2026 side by side.
- [Is It Deductible? 2026 Business Expense Finder](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/is-it-deductible/): Search 58 common small business expenses to see if they're deductible in 2026, the limits and the records to keep, with the IRS source for each.
- [Mileage Deduction Calculator 2026 (IRS Standard Rates)](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/mileage-deduction-calculator/): Calculate your 2026 business mileage deduction with the IRS standard rates, including the split between the January to June and July to December rates.
- [Paycheck Tax Calculator 2026 (Federal, FICA, NJ & NY)](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/paycheck-tax-calculator/): Estimate W-2 take-home pay per paycheck after federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare and New Jersey or New York tax.
- [Profit Margin & Markup Calculator](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/profit-margin-calculator/): Calculate gross profit margin and markup from cost and price, or the selling price for a target margin or markup. Includes a margin vs. markup guide.
- [Quarterly Estimated Tax Calculator 2026: Fed, NJ & NY](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/quarterly-estimated-tax-calculator/): Estimate your four 2026 quarterly tax payments: self-employment tax, federal income tax and NJ or NY tax, with due dates and the safe-harbor amount.
- [S Corp Tax Savings Calculator: Is an S Corp Worth It?](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/s-corp-tax-savings-calculator/): Compare self-employment tax as an LLC with payroll taxes as an S corporation. See annual savings after costs and the break-even profit.
- [2027 Business Tax Deadlines by Entity: Fed, NJ & NY](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/tax-deadlines-2027/): Every 2027 federal, New Jersey and New York tax deadline for sole proprietors, partnerships, S and C corporations, employers and nonprofits.
- [W-9 Request Email Templates for Vendors](https://mfa-advisory.com/tools/w-9-request-email-template/): Copy-ready W-9 request emails for new vendors, year-end 1099 prep and reminders. Personalize the names and deadline, then copy with one click.

- [AI Prompts for Small Business Bookkeeping & Taxes](https://mfaadvisory.gumroad.com/l/ai-prompts-small-business-bookkeeping-taxes): $6.99. 130 copy-paste AI prompts for bookkeeping, month-end close, reconciliations, Schedule C prep, quarterly estimates and 1099s, each with an expected output and a "check this" note.

## MFA Insights (articles on IRS, New Jersey and New York tax rules and deadlines)
- [MFA Insights blog](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/): all articles; [newsletter](https://mfa-advisory.com/newsletter/); [RSS feed](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/feed.xml)
- [What Tax Form Does My LLC or Corporation File? Schedule C, 1065, 1120 or 1120-S](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/which-tax-form-llc-corporation/): What tax form does a corporation or LLC file? Schedule C, Form 1065, 1120 or 1120-S, the 2027 due date for each, and who pays the tax.
- [Form 1120-S and S Corp Distributions: How They're Taxed](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/form-1120s-s-corp-guide/): Form 1120-S in plain English: who files, the March 15, 2027 due date, how S corp distributions are taxed, reasonable pay and the $260 per shareholder late penalty.
- [Form 1065 for LLCs: Who Files, Due Date, K-1s, Step by Step](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/form-1065-guide-llc/): Form 1065 for LLCs in plain English: which LLCs file it, the March 15, 2027 due date, K-1s for each member, the $260 late penalty and a step-by-step guide.
- [Adoption Tax Credit Refund 2026: IRS Sending Automatic Refunds](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/adoption-tax-credit-refund-2026/): Adoption tax credit refund 2026: the IRS is sending automatic refunds to 50,000+ families with 2020-2024 carryforwards. No amended return needed. What to check.
- [AI in Accounting and Tax: What the IRS Says in 2026](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/ai-in-accounting-and-tax-2026/): AI in accounting and tax: what the IRS's new 2026 AI guidelines say, where AI tools help with bookkeeping, and why you should verify any AI answer before you file.
- [SALT Cap 2026: The $40,400 Limit and the NJ and NY PTE Tax Fix](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/salt-cap-2026-nj-ny-pte-tax/): SALT cap 2026: you can deduct up to $40,400 in state and local taxes, less above $505,000 of income. Year-end moves plus the NJ BAIT and NY PTET workaround.
- [ANCHOR Deadline 2026: NJ Property Tax Relief Is Due Nov. 2](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/nj-property-tax-relief-anchor-stay-nj-2026/): The ANCHOR deadline for 2026 is Nov. 2. One PAS-1 form covers ANCHOR, Stay NJ (up to $6,500) and Senior Freeze. Who qualifies, amounts and who must file.
- [2027 Tax Calendar: Key IRS, New Jersey and New York Tax Deadlines](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/2027-tax-calendar/): The 2027 tax calendar: every key IRS deadline plus New Jersey and New York due dates, from 1099s and W-2s to April 15 and estimated taxes. Save it to your calendar.
- [Year-End Tax Planning 2026: 4 Dates That Can Still Lower Your Tax Bill](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/year-end-tax-planning-2026-key-dates/): Year-end tax planning 2026 in four dates: Oct. 15, Dec. 31, Jan. 15 and April 15. What to do by each one, with 2026 IRA, HSA and 401(k) limits.
- [Federal Scholarship Tax Credit 2027: The New $1,700 Credit Explained](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/federal-scholarship-tax-credit-2027/): The federal scholarship tax credit starts Jan. 1, 2027: up to $1,700 per person for cash gifts to approved scholarship groups. Who qualifies, which states, and NJ.
- [Section 179 vs. Bonus Depreciation for 2026: Year-End Equipment Guide](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/section-179-bonus-depreciation-2026/): Section 179 deduction 2026 limit is $2.56M and 100% bonus depreciation is back. How to write off equipment by Dec. 31, which to use, and the NJ catch.
- [Form 1099 Preparation Guide for 2026 Payments: The New $2,000 Rule and How to File Right](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/form-1099-preparation-guide-2026/): The 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC threshold jumps to $2,000 for 2026 payments. Who needs a 1099, the 2027 deadlines, and a step-by-step QuickBooks process to file right.
- [October 15, 2026 Tax Extension Deadline: What to Do Before It Hits](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/october-15-2026-tax-extension-deadline/): Filed an extension for your 2025 return? Your deadline is Thursday, Oct. 15, 2026. What to file, what waiting costs, and the NJ and disaster-area exceptions.
